trigger.description: The bridge target file (AGENTS.md by default, or the --file override) does not exist and --create was not passed. The run succeeds with an honest file_missing status and an info-severity degraded entry instead of inventing a file (ADR 0065 §6); export only ever creates files under explicit --create.

notes: Agents should treat this as 'decide whether the file should exist', never as an error to retry. ee import agentsmd and ee diag agentsmd-drift emit the same code (without the --create repair on import) when asked to read a missing file.
